t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It boils down to some gnomes give more mushrooms than others, but that can change throughout the game. So, be willing to change your process to verify your strategy throughout the game.

vb_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms each gnome collects changes each time you see it. I.E. the yellow gnome gives you 4 mushroom and then 2 and then 0 and then the cycle starts again. So, the 4th time you see the yellow gnome it will give you 4 mushrooms. If you can concentrate on finding the pattern in the first round you'll manage to collect loads of mushrooms in the last two rounds.
